body:
## Why

A finding marked "fix" can be left unfixed, with the PR still getting the "ready for Joe" label. It happens when a push lands while the fix job for that finding's review is starting. The fixer stops, since the commit it checked out isn't the PR's head anymore (`src/code-review/fix-input-text.ts`). The push starts a new run, and its review doesn't post the finding again, since an earlier inline comment already makes it. Then `fixRound()` in `src/code-review/fix-round.ts` counts only "fix" findings from the review of the PR's head, so it counts 0. The fix job is skipped, and the ready job adds the label. A "fix it" reply from Joe doesn't bring the finding back either: `isAskable()` needs a fixer reply marked "needs attention" first, and the fixer never replied.

## What happened

PR #240 (#230), on 2026-10-30. Its first review, of `cb806e1`, posted one finding marked "fix", an F6 on `design/technical-spec.md` (comment 4428178492). Merges of `main` into the branch were pushed while its fix job was starting. The fix job stopped with "The checked-out commit, cb806e1..., isn't the PR's head, 5588e24...". The review of the next head, `f53320c`, posted only notes. Its count step printed `fix=0`, so the fix job was skipped, and the PR got the "ready for Joe" label with the F6 finding unreplied.

## Design

- [Code review design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/code-review.md), section 4.5 (the fixer) and 4.6 (the workflow, and "A new commit cancels the review of the one before it, but not a fix job").

## Open questions

- How should a "fix" finding from an earlier review, with no fixer reply, be handled? For example: count it as pending too, have the ready job refuse the label while one is left, or only tell Joe.

## Do

- Change the loop so an unreplied "fix" finding from an earlier review can't be left behind without anyone being told. Update code review design 4.6 to match.

## Done when

- A test with a fake PR state shows an unreplied "fix" finding from an earlier review is no longer dropped.
- `npm run check` passes.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat.
